financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, including full exercise of the underwriters' option; closed Aug 22, 2025
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds to the Company from the Offering, including the full exercise by the Underwriters of their option to purchase additional shares, were approximately $53.5 million

warrants.quote: As of June 30, 2025, there were 6,824,712 warrants outstanding and not yet vested at a weighted-average exercise price of $3.48
